verdict.rationale: The docs describe a prefunded Issuing balance that you top up by pushing funds from an external bank account using Dashboard/API bank details (docs-9). They also describe a synchronous webhook that approves or declines each authorization in real time (docs-4), but that is approval control, not funding each authorization just in time. Missing for 10: evidence of a just-in-time funding model where your system funds each authorization, a documented choice between funding models, documentation of the cash-flow tradeoffs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
